What changed: an approval, not yet a contract, worth about 2.8% of Lockheed's annual revenue, spread over years. PAC-3 demand was already in the backlog story. After hours: 636.00, -0.18%.
objections: Immaterial against a $147B market cap; approval, not a contract.
